children: National Grid plc Sponsored ADR (LSE:NG.) reported first-half underlying operating profit up 13% to £2.6 billion and EPS up 22% to 36.5p. It lifted 2026/27 investment guidance to £13.5 billion and EPS growth guidance to 15%–16%.
: National Grid’s first-half underlying operating profit rose 13% to £2.6 billion and EPS gained 22% to 36.5p. It lifted 2026/27 investment guidance to £13.5 billion and EPS growth to 15%–16%.
: National Grid invested £941 million in Joulent in the first half and plans to fund the rest of its £1.3 billion commitment soon. Its $1.75 billion deal buys a 35% stake.
: National Grid secured construction and delivery arrangements for about 80% of its five-year investment programme, completing major UK tunnelling works and gaining consent for Sea Link.
: Fitch upgraded National Grid plc and two subsidiaries by one notch in June 2026, citing strong earnings visibility—a rating change relevant to NG.
: National Grid (NG.) proposed extending KEDNY and KEDLI’s New York rate plan through March 31, 2028, allowing ongoing investment and deferring eligible capital costs for future recovery.
: National Grid ADR’s average 12-month price target rose to $90.97 from $90.17. Among 16 analysts, ratings remain Buy: 10 Buy, 5 Hold and 1 Sell.
: • National Grid plc Sponsored ADR (NG.) began its H1 2027 earnings call.
